invariants.rationale: The method expects a valid camera and uses its fields without null checks.
camera.combined is used in setProjectionMatrix; it must not be null.
camera.up.y and camera.up.x are accessed; therefore, up must be non-null.
camera.position.x and camera.position.y are accessed; therefore, position must be non-null.
A positive zoom value is typically expected for proper rendering and for width and height calculations allowing correct bounds.
